scope: Final console URL policy, launcher validation, surfaced WebView2 HTTP/file interception, navigation/download checks, and scoped failure evidence. Read only; no console/window/native engine launched by this reviewer.

checks.finding: Console mode exclusively allows configured literal 127.0.0.1 HTTP origins and canonical decimal ports. It checks original authority, rejects credentials/controls/backslashes, and fails closed for absent or invalid origins.
Full-browser private-host/file environment opt-ins cannot bypass ConsoleMode. The console resolution check validates its literal target without DNS.
Launcher validates start_url and up to 32 origin strings before invoking the host launcher. Only exact about:blank or a configured literal HTTP loopback port is admitted.

Required request/frame/external-link handlers install before _consolePolicyReady becomes true. Failed installation stops/disposes the live surface; surfaced denied requests receive a 403 response rather than continuing after a log entry.

Wildcard resource-context and request-source-kind filters cover API-surfaced document/worker HTTP/file requests. Frame navigation and external application launch have separate cancellation handlers. This is not a socket firewall.

Popup errors are contained; console permissions, developer tools and default context menus cannot be enabled by broader launch opt-ins. Downloads require allowed HTTP or allowed-origin blob provenance and use the portable download path.
Native console fallback rechecks policy on each redirected target and explicitly sets req.Proxy=null, preventing inherited proxy routing at this HTTP client boundary.
Console navigation success receipts are emitted only after successful NavigationCompleted; initialization and failed navigation no longer manufacture successful presentation evidence.
Failure statuses end pending console loading without emitting a success receipt; blanking disposes the previous live surface and ignores callbacks from a replaced surface.

Harness executes extracted pure address/navigation/download/launcher validators and compiles five managed source units. All 68 reported cases pass; the five recorded changed-file hashes independently match the reviewed final files.

closedReviewFindings.issue: Native console fallback inherited ambient proxy configuration.
closedReviewFindings.resolution: req.Proxy=null is present only in ConsoleMode.

closedReviewFindings.issue: Failed NavigationCompleted emitted a successful NavigationCommitted receipt.
closedReviewFindings.resolution: Console commit emission now requires e.IsSuccess; failed console statuses clear pending loading separately.

closedReviewFindings.issue: Initialization could report the requested Source as a successful presentation before navigation completion.
closedReviewFindings.resolution: Legacy initialization commit is restricted to full-browser mode; console success commits come from successful NavigationCompleted only.

residualLimits: No browser/window/native-engine run or network capture was performed. Event lifecycle, runtime version admission and source-policy wiring need actual runtime negative tests before deployment qualification.

WebResourceRequested is not complete WebSocket/WebRTC/DNS-prefetch/browser-background/child-process/OS network confinement. Existing profiles or workers and ambient WebView proxy routing remain unverified; an OS/container rule or fully enforceable network implementation is required for a complete local-only guarantee.

Pure validator tests operate on supplied Uri strings. Browser normalization before events can canonicalize lexical numeric variants; this review certifies the checked target-policy inputs, not every raw browser input spelling.
Allowed loopback HTTP traffic is plaintext and the wrapper does not authenticate the identity of the process occupying an allowed local port.
Application state, recovery material, browser storage, downloads, logs and archive bytes have not been integrated into a JA21 encryption/wrapping pipeline.

Native JA21 engine/r12 tuple source is absent even after the second ZIP. Added workflow prose proposes future transport contracts but supplies neither cipher source nor executable 8Sphere mathematics.
The portable console is a Windows application host, not an isolated VM or a verified operating-system sandbox; law/8Sphere diagnostic labels do not supply entropy, consensus or cryptographic proof.
